title: CCSDS 124.0-B-1 interoperability harness result
description:
Contract an external executable must satisfy to be driven by run_correctness.py. The executable is invoked as:
  <exe> compress   --in F --out F --json F --packet-bytes N --R n --pt n --ft n --rt n
  <exe> decompress --in F --out F --json F --packet-bytes N --R n
It must write the payload to --out and this JSON object to --json, and exit 0 on success. Only the fields listed here are consumed; anything else is ignored.

impl.description: Identifier the wrapper declares for itself. Recorded as reported_impl in the results; never compared against the configured alias.

mode.description: Must match the mode the executable was invoked with.

rc.description: Implementation-level return code, 0 on success. Distinct from the process exit code; both are recorded and both must be 0 for the invocation to count as successful.

input_bytes.description: Size in bytes of the file passed to --in. Must match the file on disk.

output_bytes.description: Size in bytes of the payload written to --out. Must match the file on disk.

error.description: Human-readable error message. Empty or absent on success.
